verdict.rationale: Insomnia's core is an Apache-2.0 open-source desktop client. It can run entirely on user infrastructure: Local Vault storage, Git Sync to any third-party Git repo without going through the cloud, and Scratch Pad with no login required. Mock servers can also be self-hosted via Insomnia Mockbin. missing for 10: no evidence that the collaboration backend (Cloud Sync, organizations, RBAC) can be self-hosted, no self-hosting deployment guide for the overall product, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of a fully cloud-free setup.
